coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit dict-freedict-eng-por-bin.install due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient API errors during file review should trigger an automatic retry or fallback to another model, rather than immediately failing the entire audit or marking the package inconclusive.
